functions.name: LaunchTask
functions.docs:
Launches a task that executes the task body when scheduled.
The task inherits the current priority of this request owner.
The task is launched as a new request within this request owner.
@note The debug name is not copied and must remain valid for the duration of the task.

functions.name: FRequestOwner
functions.docs:
A concrete request owner that also presents as a request.
Request owners may be moved but not copied, and cancel any outstanding requests on destruction
unless KeepAlive has been called.
@see IRequestOwner

functions.name: KeepAlive
functions.docs: Keep requests in the owner alive until complete, even after destruction of the owner.

functions.name: GetPriority
functions.docs: Returns the priority that new requests are expected to inherit.

functions.name: SetPriority
functions.docs: Set the priority of active and future requests in the owner.

functions.name: Cancel
functions.docs: Cancel any active and future requests in the owner.

functions.name: Wait
functions.docs: Wait for any active and future requests or barriers in the owner.

functions.name: Poll
functions.docs: Poll whether the owner has any active requests or barriers.

functions.name: IsCanceled
functions.docs: Returns whether the owner has been canceled, which new requests are expected to check.

functions.name: End
functions.docs:
End tracking of the request.
Begins a barrier, ends the request, invokes the callback, then ends the barrier. Keeps its
reference to the request until the callback has returned.
@return The reference to the request that was held by the owner.
